flowchart TB
 subgraph intake[Order intake]
  cart([Cart ready]) --> stock{In stock?}
  stock -->|yes| reserve[Reserve items]
  stock -.->|no| wait[Wait list]
 end
 subgraph fulfil[Order fulfilment]
  charge[Take payment]
  charge --> pack[Pack order]
  pack --> ship([Dispatch])
 end
 reserve ==> charge
 wait -.-> notify[Notify buyer]
 ship -.-> receipt[Send receipt]

graph LR
 subgraph checks[Quality gate]
  lint[Lint] --> gate{All green?}
  unit[Unit tests] --> gate
  audit[Audit] -.-> gate
 end
 gate -->|pass| stage[Stage]
 gate -->|fail| repair[Repair]
 stage ==> canary[Canary]
 canary --> promote[Promote]
 repair -.-> report[Failure report]

stateDiagram-v2
 [*] --> Draft
 Draft --> Payment: submit
 state Payment {
  [*] --> Authorize
  Authorize --> Check: response
  state Check <<choice>>
  Check --> Captured: approved
  Check --> Declined: refused
  Captured --> [*]
  Declined --> [*]
 }
 note right of Authorize: Key per order
 Payment --> Packing: paid
 Packing --> Shipped: dispatch
 Shipped --> [*]

sequenceDiagram
 title Place an order
 autonumber
 actor Buyer
 participant API
 participant Stock
 participant Bank
 Buyer->>+API: Submit cart
 API->>+Stock: Reserve items
 Stock-->>-API: Hold confirmed
 Note over API,Bank: One key per order
 API->>+Bank: Authorize payment
 alt approved
  Bank-->>-API: Payment token
  loop each parcel
   API->>Stock: Queue shipment
   Stock-->>API: Tracking code
  end
  API-->>Buyer: Order accepted
 else declined
  Bank-->>API: Card declined
  API-->>Buyer: Choose another card
 end
 deactivate API
